features.title: Platform, sign-in, roles and clinics (MOD-01, Release 1)
features.summary: Clinics and dentists data, patient phone-code sign-in, staff password sign-in, role-based visibility, staff account management, erasure on request.

features.title: Dentist schedules, treatments and free slots (MOD-02, Release 1)
features.summary: Weekly hours and breaks, leave with to-move list, treatment types, free-slot calculation.

features.title: Online booking by patients (MOD-03, Release 1)
features.summary: Patient books clinic, online treatment, dentist or first available, free slot within 30 days; no double booking.

features.title: Patient appointments: view, reschedule, cancel (MOD-04, Release 1)
features.summary: My appointments list, reschedule and cancel until 4 hours before, freed slot, change messages.

features.title: Reception day view, check-in, no-shows and dentist day (MOD-05, Release 1)
features.summary: Reception day view, book/reschedule/cancel for patients, patient search/create, arrived, no-show and undo, dentist own day, status history.

features.title: Confirmations, reminders and opt-out via SMS and WhatsApp (MOD-07, Release 1)
features.summary: Channel choice, booking confirmation, 24-hour reminder with quiet hours, skip rules, reminder content with link, STOP opt-out, DLT/template compliance.

features.title: Family members on a patient account (MOD-01, Release 2)
features.summary: Patient adds up to 5 family members and books for any of them.

features.title: Repeat no-show block (MOD-06, Release 2)
features.summary: Two no-shows in 6 months block online booking and rescheduling; reception sees and lifts the block.

features.title: WhatsApp to SMS fallback and reminders-failed list (MOD-07, Release 2)
features.summary: Undelivered WhatsApp falls back once to SMS behind a switch; reminder failed state; reception list of tomorrow's failed reminders.

features.title: No-show report per clinic and month (MOD-08, Release 2)
features.summary: Manager sees no-shows and rate per clinic for the last 12 months, on screen.
